resources.string: Install and test plugins from a computer over adb
On: a computer connected over adb can install plugins. Turn it off when you\'re done.

While this is on, a computer connected with USB debugging or wireless debugging (adb) can install and update plugins without the confirmation screen, and what plugins print goes to the system log, where adb can read it. Risky permissions still stay off until you turn them on yourself. Apps on the phone cannot use it: only adb can. Turn it off when you\'re done.
